picks.thesis: Convergence: five disclosed House buys by three members (Cisneros three times, including a $100,001-250,000 band on 2026-02-09; Letlow; Allen) sit alongside a broad Form 4 buy wave. Chairman and CEO Wei Che-Chia, EVP and Co-COO Chin Yung-Pei, deputy co-COOs Hou Yung-Chin and Zhang Kevin Xiaoqiang and several VPs all bought open-market on 2026-07-07, filed within two days, with Lin Shyue-Shyh ($74,130, Jul 21) and Tien Bor-Zen (Jul 28) extending it. The insider leg is fresh; the congressional leg is roughly six months old and mostly in $1,001-15,000 bands. Individual insider tickets are small ($1,950-$74,130). Price 401.255, -7.58% over 30 days, nearer the 90-day low of 374.67 than the high of 477.57.
key_risks: Insider tickets are small in dollar terms ($1,950-$74,130) and clustered on a single date (2026-07-07), a pattern also consistent with routine or programmatic accumulation rather than discretionary conviction.
The congressional leg dates from 2026-01-30 to 2026-02-26 and is stale relative to the as-of date; only Cisneros' 2026-02-09 buy exceeded the $15,000 band.
Amount bands for congressional filings are ranges, not sizes, so the aggregate congressional dollar commitment is unknown.
Price is down 7.58% over 30 days, so the buyers disclosed here are not being confirmed by price.
picks.invalidation: The July Form 4 buy wave is not extended by further open-market insider purchases in coming filings, or insiders switch to sales, while the price breaks the 90-day low of 374.67.

Moskowitz's filing lagged 44 days, so part of the cluster was invisible for over six weeks.
All bands are small ($1,001-15,000 except Meuser's $15,001-50,000); this is not evidence of large positioning.
picks.invalidation: Members of the cluster file sales, no further congressional buys appear, or the price closes below the 90-day low of 108.37 and keeps falling.
